finding.title: All OAuth ServerResponse errors still collapse into RefreshFailed
finding.impact: Temporary server failures, invalid client configuration, unknown server errors and explicit invalid_grant remain indistinguishable; this error cannot safely authorize grant replacement/reauthorization.

exactCommittedCrate.ignoredKind: existing opt-in public discovery/JWKS live test; not executed

requiredCorrection: Introduce a finite typed distinction for confirmed invalid_grant; do not treat generic RefreshFailed as equivalent to server rejection.
Map server_error/temporarily_unavailable and relevant HTTP 503 failures to non-reauthorization temporary/network categories.
Map invalid_client and other client/request policy errors to finite configuration categories.
Keep unknown OAuth extension errors, malformed/invalid responses and missing/local unusable refresh outcomes non-reauthorizing by default.
Retain no automatic replay, raw-error redaction, owner preservation, cancellation and durable rotation ordering; add 503/config/unknown negative fixtures.
